------------------------CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO---------------------------------

WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(NUMERIC(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT1)),0) AMOUNT1_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT2)),0) AMOUNT2_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT3)),0) AMOUNT3_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT4)),0) AMOUNT4_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT5)),0) AMOUNT5_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),PERCENTAGE1)),0) PERCENTAGE1_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),PERCENTAGE2)),0) PERCENTAGE2_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),PERCENTAGE3)),0) PERCENTAGE3_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),PERCENTAGE4)),0) PERCENTAGE4_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),PERCENTAGE5)),0) PERCENTAGE5_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, AMOUNT1 AMOUNT1_src
, AMOUNT2 AMOUNT2_src
, AMOUNT3 AMOUNT3_src
, AMOUNT4 AMOUNT4_src
, AMOUNT5 AMOUNT5_src
, PERCENTAGE1 PERCENTAGE1_src
, PERCENTAGE2 PERCENTAGE2_src
, PERCENTAGE3 PERCENTAGE3_src
, PERCENTAGE4 PERCENTAGE4_src
, PERCENTAGE5 PERCENTAGE5_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, AMOUNT1_tgt
, AMOUNT2_tgt
, AMOUNT3_tgt
, AMOUNT4_tgt
, AMOUNT5_tgt
, PERCENTAGE1_tgt
, PERCENTAGE2_tgt
, PERCENTAGE3_tgt
, PERCENTAGE4_tgt
, PERCENTAGE5_tgt
, AMOUNT1_src
, AMOUNT2_src
, AMOUNT3_src
, AMOUNT4_src
, AMOUNT5_src
, PERCENTAGE1_src
, PERCENTAGE2_src
, PERCENTAGE3_src
, PERCENTAGE4_src
, PERCENTAGE5_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(AMOUNT1_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT1_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT2_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT2_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT3_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT3_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT4_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT4_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT5_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT5_tgt
,CAST(PERCENTAGE1_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE1_tgt
,CAST(PERCENTAGE2_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE2_tgt
,CAST(PERCENTAGE3_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE3_tgt
,CAST(PERCENTAGE4_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE4_tgt
,CAST(PERCENTAGE5_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE5_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT1_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT1_src
,CAST(AMOUNT2_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT2_src
,CAST(AMOUNT3_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT3_src
,CAST(AMOUNT4_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT4_src
,CAST(AMOUNT5_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AMOUNT5_src
,CAST(PERCENTAGE1_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE1_src
,CAST(PERCENTAGE2_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE2_src
,CAST(PERCENTAGE3_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE3_src
,CAST(PERCENTAGE4_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE4_src
,CAST(PERCENTAGE5_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) PERCENTAGE5_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, AMOUNT1_src
, AMOUNT2_src
, AMOUNT3_src
, AMOUNT4_src
, AMOUNT5_src
, PERCENTAGE1_src
, PERCENTAGE2_src
, PERCENTAGE3_src
, PERCENTAGE4_src
, PERCENTAGE5_src
)
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, AMOUNT1_tgt
, AMOUNT2_tgt
, AMOUNT3_tgt
, AMOUNT4_tgt
, AMOUNT5_tgt
, PERCENTAGE1_tgt
, PERCENTAGE2_tgt
, PERCENTAGE3_tgt
, PERCENTAGE4_tgt
, PERCENTAGE5_tgt
)
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
